Major gym refurbishment at Mile End From Wednesday 12 August, the gym at Mile End will be undergoing a major refurbishment to improve facilities and equipment. The gym will remain open throughout the works, although some workout areas and equipment will be temporarily unavailable at different stages of the project. Read more about the refurbishment and planned closures. Mile End Park Leisure Centre and Stadium Discover holistic wellbeing at Mile End Leisure Centre and Stadium where cutting-edge facilities, classes and treatments come together. Our offering includes gym, with cardio, strength, and training zones, and an exclusive women-only gym. Our dynamic studio has fitness classes ranging from Zumba and boxfit to yoga, and a dedicated spin studio for group cycle sessions. Our 25-metre swimming pool and teaching pool hosts a variety of swim activities, including swimming lessons. Our sports hall features basketball, gymnastics, trampolining, fencing and a dedicated soft play mega structure. Explore additional perks including meeting rooms, an athletics stadium with a spectator grandstand, an 11-aside astro pitch for hockey and football, 3G pitches, and netball and tennis courts. Complete your experience in our health suite, boasting a sauna, steam room, spa, and relaxation area. Mile End Centre and Stadium – where health, wellness, and play unite.
